VaultSecurityProfile.title: VaultSecurityProfile
VaultSecurityProfile.description: Per-user PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 salt and verifier hash used for client-side AES-256-GCM encryption and passcode lock across devices.

verifierHashBase64.description: Base64-encoded SHA-256 verifier hash of derived key.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when vault passcode was initialized (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when vault passcode was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

JournalTag.title: JournalTag
JournalTag.description: User-created custom tag for categorizing and filtering journal entries.

name.description: Tag display name (e.g., Work, Family, Travel, Ideas, Health).

colorHex.description: Hex color code for tag badge (#RRGGBB).

JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: End-to-end AES-256-GCM encrypted personal journal entry with mood tracking, daily gratitude prompt reflection, tags, and compressed encrypted photo attachment.

encryptedTitle.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted title payload (iv:ciphertext in Base64).

encryptedBody.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted journal body payload (iv:ciphertext in Base64).

encryptedGratitudeResponse.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted response to the daily gratitude prompt (or empty string).

gratitudePromptText.description: The daily gratitude prompt question presented for this entry.

mood.description: Mood state associated with the journal entry.

tagIds.description: Bounded list of up to 20 JournalTag document IDs associated with this entry.

encryptedPhotoBase64.description: Optional AES-256-GCM encrypted compressed JPEG photo attachment (or empty string).

entryDateEpochMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of the journal entry date.

ExpenseItem.title: ExpenseItem
ExpenseItem.description: Daily financial expense record for personal spending habit monitoring.

encryptedTitle.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted merchant or expense title.

encryptedNotes.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted expense notes (or empty string).

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

WorldClockItem.title: WorldClockItem
WorldClockItem.description: Saved world timezone clock synced across user devices.

/users/{userId}/security/{docId}.description: Per-user vault passcode KDF salt and verifier document (docId = 'vault_config').

/users/{userId}/tags/{tagId}.description: Custom journal tags created by the user.

/users/{userId}/journals/{entryId}.description: Encrypted personal journal entries with mood, gratitude prompt, tags, and encrypted photo.

/users/{userId}/expenses/{expenseId}.description: Daily financial expense logs for spending tracking.
